The lane's new gate allows max(8 %, pre-grade share), which encodes a looser reading than the ruling's text ('zones are hue-shifted or desaturated until the cap holds'). Odrum 38.6, Sukri 20.0, Dunsom 16.5 and Ulkro 12.8 also sit over the cap from their bakes.
problems.evidence: My reserved_pct run over art/out/fighters/*/*.glb (scratchpad r32.py) reproduces the engineer's numbers. The engineer reported it and relaxed nothing, so this is an open lead ruling, not a hidden miss. It still keeps the lane from passing.
problems.fix: The lead rules whether the cap covers whole bakes and whether HSV saturation is the right measure for dark browns (V around 0.29). Until then, either desaturate Burdam's bake browns under the cap, keeping the oxblood coat at hue around 1 degree, outside the 28-50 degree band, or record the ruling's scope in owner_rulings.md.
